title: 第17章 荒古遗种第18章 世界的成长性
content_zh:
陆战走后，陆宸立刻回到了石珠世界。
因为不同世界的时间差，当陆宸再次进入石珠世界时，原本不太精神的没毛老鼠精神了很多。
此刻，它正一屁股坐在土灵晶堆上，不停的啃着土灵晶。
在一阵咯吱咯吱的声响中，一块拳头大小的土灵晶三两口就被它吃进了肚子里，渣都不剩一点。
仔细一看，陆宸发现原本五十多万的灵晶堆，里面才过几天时间，灵晶却少了将近二十分之一。
想到一只老鼠几天时间吃掉几万块灵晶，陆宸倒吸了一口凉气，抬腿朝着没毛老鼠走了过去。
陆宸肉疼的指着灵晶堆问道：“大老鼠，在我进入小鼎世界的这段时间，你吃了我多少灵晶？”
“什么大老鼠，叫我鼠爷。”
闻言，抱着一块灵晶正准备啃的没毛老鼠停了下来，愤怒的瞪着陆宸。
“鼠爷？”
陆宸鄙视道：“让我叫你一只丑不拉几的老鼠鼠爷，别做梦了好吧。”
“臭—小—子，我看你是皮痒了，居然敢说我丑！”
没毛老鼠对着陆宸怒吼，紧接着，它居然消失了。
同一时间，陆宸脸色大变，感受到一股的危险在靠近。
一瞬间，陆宸如临大敌，调动全身灵力对着身后轰出一拳，因为他察觉到身后有风的律动。
“臭小子，感知不错，但是速度太慢了。”
没毛老鼠的声音传来。
之后，不等陆宸反应，原本身后的没毛老鼠突然现身左侧面，一只肉嘟嘟的爪子直接蹬在了陆宸的屁股上。
“不好！”
感受着没毛老鼠爪子中蕴藏的恐怖力量，陆宸大惊道。

“臭小子，这会不好已经晚了。”
没毛老鼠戏谑道。
下一秒，陆宸的屁股被没毛老鼠一爪子击中，只见轰的一声，陆宸飞出了十几米，整个人砸进了沙堆。
“好痛！”
陆宸忍着剧痛站了起来。
“痛就对了，谁叫你嘴巴不干净，不懂得尊老爱幼。”
陆宸前脚站起，没毛老鼠又出现了，这一次，陆宸还没反应过来就又对着沙堆来了一个狗吃屎。
“操啊！”
接连两次被揍，陆宸只感觉骨头都要被这只该死的没毛老鼠踹断了，全身疼痛难忍，气血翻腾。
content_en:
After Lu Zhan left, Lu Chen immediately returned to the Shizhu World.
Because of the time difference between different worlds, when Lu Chen entered the world of Shizhu again, the hairless mouse who was originally not very energetic became much more energetic.
At this moment, it was sitting on the pile of earth spirit crystals, chewing on the earth spirit crystals.
Amidst a crunching sound, a piece of earth spirit crystal the size of a fist was eaten into its stomach in two or two mouthfuls, leaving no trace left.
Taking a closer look, Lu Chen found that the pile of more than half a million spiritual crystals that had only been in it for a few days had lost nearly one-twentieth of the spiritual crystals.
Thinking of a mouse eating tens of thousands of spiritual crystals in a few days, Lu Chen took a breath of cold air, raised his legs and walked towards the hairless mouse.
Lu Chen pointed at the pile of spiritual crystals with pain and asked: "Big Mouse, how many spiritual crystals did you eat from me during the time I entered the world of Xiaoding?"
"What a big rat, call me Lord Rat."
Hearing this, the hairless mouse, which was holding a piece of spiritual crystal and was about to chew it, stopped and glared at Lu Chen angrily.
"Master Mouse?"
Lu Chen said with disdain: "Let me call you an ugly mouse. Stop dreaming."
"You little brat, I think your skin is itchy. How dare you call me ugly!"
The hairless mouse roared at Lu Chen, and then it disappeared.
At the same time, Lu Chen's expression changed drastically, and he felt a sense of danger approaching.
For a moment, Lu Chen felt as if he was facing a formidable enemy. He mobilized all his spiritual power to punch behind him because he noticed the rhythm of the wind behind him.
"You brat, your perception is good, but your speed is too slow."
came the sound of a hairless mouse.
Afterwards, without waiting for Lu Chen to react, the hairless mouse behind him suddenly appeared on the left side, and a fleshy paw directly kicked Lu Chen's butt.
"Not good!"
Feeling the terrifying power contained in the hairless mouse's claws, Lu Chen was shocked.
"You brat, it's already too late."
The hairless mouse joked.
The next second, Lu Chen's buttocks were hit by the paw of a hairless mouse. With a bang, Lu Chen flew more than ten meters and was smashed into the sand.
"It hurts!"
Lu Chen endured the severe pain and stood up.
"It hurts, that's right. You have a dirty mouth and don't know how to respect the old and care for the young."
Lu Chen stood up on his front feet, and the hairless mouse appeared again. This time, before Lu Chen could react, another dog came to eat shit in the sand.
"Fuck!"
After being beaten twice in succession, Lu Chen felt as if his bones were about to be broken by the kick of this damn hairless mouse. His whole body was in unbearable pain and his blood was boiling.
